ATCC Medium 2 separates commercial powder from its scratch agar-minus-agar branch; DSMZ1510 and solution3119 list extra casein digest, soy peptone, malt extract and agar outside the broth product. Frozen TOGO flattening and water-unit anomalies are retained as source context, not adopted as product composition. The manufacturer labels the printed broth table an approximate formula per litre and permits adjustment or supplementation to meet performance criteria. COMPLETE covers all 16 nominal printed dry-product inputs, not exact chemical closure for every manufactured lot. The existing component names and quantities remain unchanged on their standard-reconstitution basis; water remains outside the dry product, and unspecified salt forms and generic Peptone remain unresolved. No extra ingredient, lot-specific adjustment or forced PARTIAL status is inferred.
